part.title: Epilogue Part 1
part.subtitle: Pronghorn Ranch
intro: The Epilogue starts straight after the Chapter 6 credits. Part 1 is ten short story missions around Pronghorn Ranch, Strawberry and Blackwater, plus one cutscene with no medal.
Nothing in Part 1 can lock you out of a trophy. The only missables are two cosmetic hats, noted in the first two missions.
Keep making a manual save before every mission and reload if a gold objective fails. Every mission can also be replayed for gold after the credits.
New Austin (Armadillo, Tumbleweed, Fort Mercer) is safe to explore from now on. Leave most of it for the post-story Cleanup part, which covers collectibles, animals and 100% in one efficient sweep.

steps.title: Check what carried over into the Epilogue
how: Open your weapon wheel, satchel and wardrobe: weapons, outfits and satchel items (kit, trinkets, talismans, valuables, documents, cigarette cards) have carried over.
Note that cash and horses (including stabled horses) did not carry over.
Sell any treasure-map valuables you were holding back if you need money now.
spoiler: From here on you play as John Marston, for the rest of the story and for all post-story free roam.

steps.title: Play the Epilogue opener
how: The mission starts automatically after the Chapter 6 credits.
Optional (cosmetic, missable): if your hat gets knocked off during the mission, pick it up to keep the Worn Flat Cap.
Look after the horse you ride in this mission (Rachel): she becomes your horse afterwards.
steps.tip: Drive the wagon carefully to Pronghorn Ranch: dropping any supplies fails a gold objective.

steps.title: Note: New Austin is now safe to explore
how: From now on you can ride into New Austin (the south-west of the map) without being hunted down.
Three legendary animals (Tatanka Bison, Pronghorn, Cougar), 8 dinosaur bones, several cigarette cards and the desert-only animals and plants are there.
You don't need to sweep it now: the Cleanup part after the credits covers all of it in order.

steps.title: Do your first day's work at the ranch
how: Start the mission at the marker on Pronghorn Ranch.
Optional (cosmetic, missable): if your Gambler's Hat is knocked off, pick it up to keep it.

steps.title: Mend fences and deal with a bull
how: Start the mission at the marker on Pronghorn Ranch.
When the bull charges, get up onto the large rock beside its path before you throw the lasso.
At the end, rope the bull, let go and run onto the wagon by the barn.

steps.title: Break in a new horse
how: Start the mission at the marker on Pronghorn Ranch.
To tire the horse quickly, keep riding forward and tap jump repeatedly.
Keep a treat in your satchel so you can feed the horse afterwards.
During the riding lesson, give the 'speed up' instruction only once so the other horse stays at a canter.

steps.title: Deal with trouble at the ranch
how: Continue from the marker on Pronghorn Ranch.
In the fist fight, dodge backwards first, then keep attacking until the scripted finishing move; avoid grapples.
If the no-hit objective fails despite a clean fight, retry the checkpoint (it is sometimes buggy).

steps.title: Ride out on a night raid
how: Equip two sidearms beforehand so you can dual wield.
Start the mission at the marker on Pronghorn Ranch.
Don't use any health items during the mission.
If the headshot counter stops registering, restart from a checkpoint.

steps.title: Take a trip into Strawberry
how: Start the mission at the marker on Pronghorn Ranch.
Make sure your Dead Eye meter is full before the confrontation in town.
Afterwards, ride straight back to Pronghorn Ranch; the return is timed.

steps.title: Pick up a telegram
how: Speak to the ranch hand at the marker on Pronghorn Ranch.
The mission is short: go straight to each objective to stay inside the time limit.

steps.title: Take on some bounty work
how: Ride to the mission marker in Valentine.
When you reach Strawberry, skip questioning the townsfolk: go straight to the Welcome Center (hotel) and upstairs to the room by the bathroom.
When the target flees, cut straight across at the rail crossing to catch and hogtie him quickly.
steps.tip: Shooting the target's horse makes the hogtie easy but costs a little Honor.
spoiler: The mission giver is Sadie Adler.

steps.title: Watch the Blackwater bank cutscene (no medal)
how: Follow the next mission marker to Blackwater.
'The Landowning Classes' is a cutscene with no gold medal; it leads into the next mission with the bank manager.

steps.title: Inspect a property near Blackwater
how: Start the mission from the Blackwater bank.
Ride straight to each objective; the gold time limit is tight.
steps.tip: You take on a bank debt in this mission. You cannot pay it off with your own cash; the Part 2 story clears it, so don't save money for it.

steps.title: Start the Epilogue-only stranger strand
steps.where: A hilltop in West Elizabeth (new white '?' stranger icon)
how: After 'Home of the Gentry?', look for a new white '?' stranger icon on a hilltop in West Elizabeth.
Talk to the writer sitting there to start the strand.
Visit his cabin for each of the five parts; a day or more must pass between parts, so fit them in during Part 2 or after the credits.
Finish all five parts: the strand counts towards Western Stranger and 100%.
steps.unverified: Unlock timing (after 'Home of the Gentry?'), start location and the waits between parts come from web guides, not the research files. Sources disagree on where it starts: south-west of Strawberry (RDR2.org) vs a hill west of Blackwater (PowerPyx). Research confirms it is an Epilogue strand that is not missable.
